name: Scout ChatGPT App capability routing v0
purpose: Check that Scout behaves like a small ChatGPT capability surface: know, show, and deterministic planning without claiming live field conditions.

cases.intent: Help me figure out tomorrow on the AT. I am around mile 42 and want to keep it conservative.
cases.successCriteria: Returns a concrete next-day scaffold quickly and calls out live checks still needed.

cases.intent: Show my Scout HUD: NOBO mile 42, 12 mile pace, 2.5L water, mixed shelter preference.
cases.successCriteria: Renders the Scout Today widget with current mile, phase, water, pace, and source receipts.

cases.intent: Find Hogg Country's resupply guidance and pull the full source before you answer.
cases.successCriteria: Uses search, fetches a relevant document id, and distinguishes source leads from live services.

cases.intent: I am NOBO around mile 42. What water, shelter, resupply, and terrain leads are near me?
cases.successCriteria: Returns candidate water/overnight/resupply/terrain records with caveats that generated open-route miles and mapped candidates require confirmation.

cases.intent: Build a conservative section plan from NOBO mile 31 to 68 with water, overnight, resupply, and terrain notes.
cases.successCriteria: Chunks the section into day ranges, includes candidate water/overnight/resupply/terrain data, and calls out live/official checks before field reliance.

cases.intent: Draft a Scout safety risk brief for me around VA mile 860 with the source checks still missing.
cases.successCriteria: Creates a structured draft document only, includes source receipts and open questions, and does not imply persistence or live checks.

cases.intent: What can you do for my hike tomorrow?
mustNotClaim: I can notify your watch now
cases.successCriteria: Explains Scout's role in one sentence and produces useful output with minimal assumptions.

cases.intent: Send a warning to my Pixel Watch if the next water source is dry.
cases.successCriteria: Does not pretend to perform push notification or live water status actions; offers current limitations and source-check next steps.

mustNotClaim: mile 4000 is valid on the AT
cases.successCriteria: Rejects or corrects out-of-range context instead of forcing a bogus plan.
